purpose: Test whether the frozen original full question preserves query-document constraints that were lost by the Agent's 48 generated search queries, using the identical pinned Qwen3 dense index and seven persistent misses.

comparison.baseline: best rank across the same case's frozen successful Agent-generated queries
comparison.rank_win_policy: raw rank is lower than generated best rank; an observed raw rank beats a missing generated rank; two missing ranks are a tie

claim_boundary: This is a posthoc, gold-aware retrieval-rank diagnostic on an outcome-selected failure cluster. The gold-blind builder may read only the frozen question artifact and must persist all top-1000 rankings before the scorer opens gold or prior outcomes. A pass can select a separately registered raw-question anchor or candidate-pool experiment; it cannot establish end-to-end effectiveness, official accuracy, leaderboard performance, or model capability improvement.
